research.title: Semantic Segmentation Robustness Under Image Corruptions
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing segmentation models under blur, sensor noise, and illumination changes, holding training data and evaluation procedures constant.
Analyzed classwise overlap and boundary errors across corruption conditions, distinguishing failures on small objects from degradation in large homogeneous regions.

research.title: Confidence Calibration for Visual Recognition Under Domain Shift
bullets: Designed experiments evaluating temperature scaling for image classifiers across source and shifted domains, using separate calibration and evaluation partitions.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, calibration error, and selective prediction behavior to characterize confidence mismatches associated with background and texture changes.

research.title: Training Data Composition and Fine-Grained Visual Recognition
bullets: Designed ablation experiments examining class imbalance, image resolution, and augmentation choices in fine-grained recognition while controlling architecture and optimization settings.
Analyzed confusion patterns and repeated training runs to assess whether classification errors reflected visual similarity, limited examples, or background dependence.

work.title: Image Ingestion and Preprocessing Utilities
bullets: Implemented image validation and preprocessing utilities for an existing application, handling unsupported formats, inconsistent dimensions, and malformed inputs.
Added regression tests for preprocessing edge cases and investigated ingestion failures using application logs and reproducible sample inputs.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented image alignment pipelines using SIFT and ORB descriptors, nearest neighbor matching, and robust homography estimation.
Compared alignment accuracy and runtime across viewpoint and lighting changes, inspecting mismatches in repetitive textures and low detail regions.

projects.title: Encoder–Decoder Architectures for Foreground Segmentation
bullets: Implemented U-Net and a fully convolutional baseline for foreground segmentation, using matched preprocessing, training splits, and loss functions.
Compared overlap scores and boundary quality, examining how skip connections affected thin structures and objects with ambiguous foreground boundaries.

projects.title: Transfer Learning Strategies for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and partial fine-tuning with pretrained convolutional networks, maintaining consistent classification heads and data partitions.
Compared validation performance and training cost across adaptation strategies, examining sensitivity to training set composition and augmentation choices.

projects.title: Classical Optical Flow Under Challenging Motion
bullets: Implemented Lucas–Kanade and Horn–Schunck optical flow estimators with image pyramids to compare local and global motion estimation.
Evaluated endpoint errors on synthetic image pairs with known displacement, inspecting failures near occlusions, motion boundaries, and textureless regions.
